identity.title: [v0.92][WP-14 follow-up] Repair production ACIP dispatch, replay isolation, and public contract

values.summary: Bind the production dispatch and replay authority contract, implement the narrow repair, prove exact behavior and portability, resolve independent review, then publish and merge before refreshing #5834.

steps.action: Map the production Guardian/kernel dispatch boundary, queue/error model, replay identity, and public schema contract.
Implement production dispatch, bounded pressure/typed errors, scoped replay state, and OpenAPI parity.
Add focused positive/adversarial tests and issue-local exact native proof surfaces.
Resolve fresh exact-head review, publish a qualified PR, shepherd exact green checks, and merge through typed finish.

invariants: Admission precedes dispatch and replay-state advancement
Replay state never crosses authenticated principal or replay-domain boundaries
Durable/public contracts describe exactly what production runtime enforces
Pressure or dispatch failure returns a bounded typed error and does not leak private material
All retained evidence is exact-revision and repository-relative
risks: A test-only listener could again substitute for production dispatch
Replay namespacing could permit duplicate reuse across poorly defined domains
Pressure tests could accidentally prove only frame-size limits
Schema changes could diverge from runtime serialization or compatibility behavior
stop_conditions: No existing bounded Guardian/kernel operation can be safely exposed through this issue
The repair requires a broad transport redesign beyond reviewed findings
Any proposed edit targets #5834 product, PR197, PR191, Sprint 3, or unrelated global CI
Focused proof or exact-head review finds an unresolved authority bypass
